The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Sangeetha.S..
The gist of the prosecution case is that, complainant got married accused No.1 on 09-12-2016.

At the time of marriage, as per the demand made by accused persons, the parents of the complainant had given Rs.3 lakhs in cash as dowry and had given gold and silver ornaments and also household items as dowry.

After the marriage, when complainant was residing with accused No.1 and 2 at Thyagarajanagar, Bangalore, accused No.2 used to instigate accused No.1 and they were telling complainant not to go to her paternal house and used to quarrel with her.

Whenever complainant used to go to her paternal house, accused No.1 and 2 used to quarrel with the complainant and used to demand to bring cash and gold ornaments and also demanded her to give her salary and abused her in foul and filthy language and assaulted her.
 3  C.C.No.27570/2019 When complainant told she has to clear the loan made by her parents for marriage, out of her salary, accused persons told complainant let her parents clear the loan and abused her and assaulted her.
When complainant was pregnant, accused no.1 did not take her to the hospital and he was not providing food.
When complainant delivered girl baby accused No.1 and 2 abused her by saying that they wanted a male child.

2 complainant to bring Rs.10 lakhs from her father and took away the gold ornaments and also salary of the complainant and told complainant that if she does not bring Rs.10 lakhs from her paternal house they would give divorce and caused physical and mental cruelty in demand of dowry.
Based on the information of Smt.Sangeetha.S., a case in Cr.No.117/2019 came to be registered against the accused No.1 and 2 for the aforesaid offences .

sentences.text: I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused No.1 and 2 caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry,
 assaulted her, abused her in foul and filthy language  and thereby accused No.1 and 2 have committed the  offences punishable U/s.498(A) of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of  Dowry Prohibition Act?
 2) what order?
 5  C.C.No.27570/2019  8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:-
 R E A SON S 9.POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused persons, the prosecution has examined complainant Smt.
Sangeetha as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P.2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement and Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.

10. PW-1 in her examination-in-chief deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 09-12-2016 and after the marriage, accused No.1 and 2 looked after her well and deposed accused No.1 and 2 did not subjected her to any physical Sangeetha S vs Ramesha Kumar on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83921547/
4 and mental cruelty in demand of dowry.

PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused No.1 and 2 in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station, there the police have took her signature on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature  6  C.C.No.27570/2019 at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P1.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused persons have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
Though PW-1 was cross examined by the prosecution, nothing worth could be elicited.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness has turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
